clauses.statement: Source: CachedResponse now carries status; transport.rs records status.as_u16() via record_response_with_status and forward/mod.rs replays it via try_cache_hit_with_status. Observation: bridge_replays_original_upstream_status passes (429 replays as 429).

Boundary probe: the change is confined to the cache struct, bridge, and the two call sites; try_cache_hit/record_response keep signatures (record defaults to 200), so the existing key-match/miss test and the 200 replay path are unchanged. Observation: all 223 ocla-filtered lib tests and the 7 ocla_integration_suite tests (which constructs CachedResponse) pass. wire_middleware's separate CachedResponse is untouched. No revision to the patch was justified.

Unresolved: error responses are still cached (existing behavior, now replayed with status), which may be broader than desired; response headers like content-type are not replayed; forward/mod.rs and transport.rs have no end-to-end test. Not verified by any command here.
